patch_description: I redesigned the ansatz as a mirrored, dual-axis block: symmetric RY pre-rotations, symmetric RX mixing on a complementary set of wires, followed by local CZ entanglement and long-range CRZ couplings. This keeps the circuit expressive for re-uploading while reducing the number of free circuit parameters per block, which should improve parameter efficiency and help generalization without changing the fixed training pipeline or outputs.
